meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理神经影像数据为BIDS标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理MRI/EEG等神经影像数据并需要符合BIDS标准。
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroimaging data into BIDS standard format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with MRI/EEG neuroimaging data and need BIDS compliance.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你整理神经科学数据（MRI、EEG 等）为 BIDS 标准格式，查询数据集、验证合规性、转换 DICOM 文件、编写元数据 JSON 文件。
howto.when: 当你需要组织或处理脑成像数据，例如整理原始数据、查询已有数据集、验证格式、转换 DICOM 到 BIDS 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 PyBIDS 查询这个 BIDS 数据集里所有 T1w 文件。
say.note: Claude 会调用 PyBIDS 库列出文件路径。

say.text: 验证这个文件夹是否符合 BIDS 标准。
say.note: Claude 会运行 bids-validator 检查。

say.text: 用 HeuDiConv 把 DICOM 目录转换成 BIDS 格式。
say.note: Claude 会指导或执行转换命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you organize neuroscience data (MRI, EEG, etc.) into BIDS standard format, query datasets, validate compliance, convert DICOM files, and write metadata JSON files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to organize or process brain imaging data, such as organizing raw data, querying existing datasets, validating format, or converting DICOM to BIDS.

say_en.text: Query all T1w files in this BIDS dataset using PyBIDS.
say_en.note: Claude will use PyBIDS to list file paths.

say_en.text: Validate this folder against the BIDS specification.
say_en.note: Claude will run bids-validator to check.

say_en.text: Convert this DICOM directory to BIDS using HeuDiConv.
say_en.note: Claude will guide or execute the conversion command.
